correctness.rationale: The source backtracking enumerates all oriented rooted length-20 Hamilton paths and divides only by reverse orientation. An independent complementary-perfect-matching census finds 36 matchings, precisely 30 with connected Hamiltonian complements, and reconstructs 60 eight-edge exchanges, 4-regular connectivity and diameter four. The base girth five and cubic Hamiltonian symmetric difference excludes alternating 4- and 6-cycles. Antipodal pairing gives fifteen quotient vertices and 30 edges; ten quotient triangles each belong to the correct incidence pattern, whose triangle-intersection graph is the ten-vertex cubic (10,3,0,1) Petersen graph. Edge lifts join opposite bipartite colors, proving the tensor-product identification. The entire finite search space is explicit and exhausted; it is not an infinite generalized Petersen claim.

final_claim: For the dodecahedral graph GP(10,2), the shortest allowed alternating single-cycle symmetric-difference exchanges connecting its 30 Hamiltonian cycles have length eight. The exchange graph R8 is four-regular on 30 vertices, has 60 edges and diameter four, and is isomorphic to the bipartite double cover K2 tensor L(Petersen).
limitations: Only the fixed 20-vertex GP(10,2), not an infinite generalized Petersen family.
